friendly_name: hn serve: governed local Git server
purpose_context: Hubnot checks policy and evidence only on the client today, so any credential with push access can move main directly, and multi-agent use needs manual per-actor and per-proposal selection. hn serve is an optional server that maps SSH keys to Hubnot actors, enforces governed protected-branch updates, advances main only to tested commits, fans out trusted facts to clients, and serves Git LFS objects, while every existing workflow over an ordinary Git remote keeps working.
purpose_tldr: Add an optional hn serve command that hosts repositories over SSH and refuses protected-branch updates that lack Hubnot governance evidence.
